prompts.ima: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: rear base photograph for a reusable ecommerce round refrigerator-magnet mockup. Edit target: the attached unbranded silver circular button BACK base, transparent background. Change ONLY the hardware in the central inset disc: REMOVE the horizontal safety pin and both clasps completely, and replace that entire inner round inset with a single flat round BLACK ferrite/rubber magnet glued centrally to the metal back. It should read as a continuous opaque matte black magnetic disc, with only a fine realistic bevel and extremely subtle texture/highlight, not gray metal, not a small black dot. Keep the existing silver outer rolled rim and all areas outside the inner inset EXACTLY unchanged, preserve circular silhouette, orthographic camera, object center, same square canvas, same object diameter and transparent margins, same lighting from upper left. The magnet must fully hide all remnants of pin/clasps. One object, complete rear face, no perspective, no floor or external shadow, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no checkerboard painted into the image. Real transparent alpha outside the object. This is a replacement back for the same circular product shell, not a new product shape.
prompts.espelho: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: rear base photograph for a reusable ecommerce personalized round pocket mirror mockup. Edit target: the attached unbranded round silver button BACK on transparent alpha. Change ONLY the inner inset and hardware: REMOVE the horizontal safety pin and BOTH clasps completely. Replace the central inset disc with a real flat circular MIRROR GLASS insert, occupying the full inset. The mirror must look optically smooth, reflective and clean, with a delicate thin bevel at its circumference and broad soft diagonal white and cool-gray studio reflections, clearly different from brushed steel. No reflected people, room, camera, objects or scenery. Keep the outer rolled metal rim, outer silhouette, circle size, object center, square framing, transparent margins, lighting and camera EXACTLY unchanged. Perfect front-on orthographic view of the back face, one object only. No handles, hinge, stand, pin or hardware. Transparent background, no floor, no external shadow, no labels, logos or watermarks. This is the same round product shell with a mirror rear insert, not a new shape. Do not flatten the rim details or make the mirror a small dot.
prompts.abridor: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: BACK base photograph for the same round personalized button product, now with a bottle-opener back. Edit target: attached circular unbranded silver button rear with safety pin. REMOVE the safety pin, wire and both clasps completely. Replace ONLY the central inset hardware with a realistic stamped stainless-steel BOTTLE OPENER insert, as used on round promotional button badge bottle openers. It is a flat circular metal back with a clearly visible horizontal elongated rectangular/rounded cap-removal opening near the center and a raised inward curved metal lifting tooth/lip on one edge of that opening; the opening should occupy about 45 percent of the inner disc width so the function is unmistakable. Fine brushed steel and natural tiny shadows around the useful opening, no black magnet, no pin, no keyring, no handle, no screw, no extra item. Keep the existing outer rolled circular silver rim and every area outside the central inset EXACTLY unchanged, same silhouette, object center, size, square canvas, alpha transparency margins and upper-left studio lighting. Perfectly straight-on orthographic back view, one complete round object. Transparent background outside the object; no floor, no exterior cast shadow, no lettering, logos or watermark. Do not create an ordinary handheld long opener or a soda pull tab. Only the closure changes; the round product shell is identical.
